NARRATIVE AND PLANS

Re: 323-335 E. 53rd St.; 5300-5318 S. Calumet Ave.
The Applicant seeks a change in zoning from RMS Residential Multi-Unit District to RM6 Residential Multi-
Unit District.

The applicant proposes to construct a 71 dwelling unit elderly housing building. The building will provide
housing for elderly residents with accessory uses to support elder care. The dwelling units include studios,
1-bedrooms units, and (for elderly residents caring for grandchildren) some 2- and 3-bedroom units.

Lot Area: 30,745 square feet
(existing, per survey)

Floor Area Ratio (maximum): 2.41

Dwelling Units (maximum): 71 dwelling units

Off-Street Parking (minimum)*: 24 parking spaces*

Front Setback (minimum)**: 0 feet, 0 inches (parking / access road)**
(north / 53rd Street)

Side Setback (minimum)**: 3 feet, 0 inches**

(east / Calumet Avenue)

Side Setback (minimum)**: 0 feet, 0 inches (parking / access road)**
(west)

Rear Setback (minimum)**: 30 feet, 0 inches (building)**

(south)

Building Height: 78 feet, 4 inches

Note: The property is being developed as a Reversed Comer Lot.

*The property is eligible for a transit-served location parking space reduction, pursuant to Chicago Zoning
Ordinance § 17-13-1003-EE.

**Tncludes variation reductions for front setback, side setbacks, and rear setback — all pursuant to Chicago
Zoning Ordinance § 17-13-1101-B.
